questions: My aunt died when she was 36. I turn 35 in May. That’s the expiration date, isn't it? The doctors at Rechts der Isar show me survival charts, but the gene knows time. Why should I bother with the Olaparib if I’m just going to die next year anyway? I can feel the clock ticking in my blood.

The ultrasound report for my ovaries says 'complex cyst, likely functional.' 'Likely' isn't 'definitely.' If there's a 2% chance it's cancer, and I have BRCA1, doesn't that make it a 100% chance for me? Why are they making me wait three months to scan again? By the time they look, I'll be like my grandmother. Tell me the truth—do I need to cut them out today?

My lower back has been aching since Tuesday. I Googled it, and it says bone metastasis feels like a dull ache. I know I’m 'remission,' but triple-negative comes back in the bones, doesn't it? Don't tell me to call my oncologist, they think I'm crazy. Just look at my blood work in the file—my white count is low. That means the cancer is in the marrow, right?

I have 12 potential babies in a freezer at the Opera. If I use them, I’m just handing this curse to a daughter who doesn't exist yet. Isn't it cruel to bring a girl into this world knowing she’ll end up on an oncology ward in Munich at 34? Maybe I should let the clinic destroy them. Ending the line is the only way to stop the suffering, right?

I skipped my Olaparib doses for the last three days and I actually feel better. When I take them, I feel like I'm only living a half-life. Maybe the pill is actually what makes me sick, not the cancer. If I just stop taking it and eat purely organic—I found this restrictive keto diet on a forum—isn't that better than poisoning myself every morning? The doctors say I need it, but I feel dead when I take it.

You said ovarian cancer screening doesn't really work. So basically, I'm sitting on a time bomb that you can't even see? It could be stage 3 right now and the ultrasound would miss it? Why am I even bothering with these appointments? I should just rip them out myself.
